name: Norwood Financial Corp.
summary: Norwood Financial Corp. operates as the bank holding company for Wayne Bank that provides various banking products and services in the United States. The company offers deposit products, including interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing transaction, statement savings, and money market accounts, as well as certificate of deposits.
